t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Usually, the gnome with the higher hat has the most mushrooms to collect, but not always. There might be another pattern; the previous participant didn't identify this or provide any further guidance.

vb_textbox.text: The participant before me advised that the gnome with the higher hat would usually collect more mushrooms, but I don't believe this to be the case. I also could not identify any rules, but I did rule some things out, which may help you figure out the rules (if there are any). Specifically:I tried picking the gnome that was most similar to the colour of the previous basket. For example, if the previous basket was red and the next gnomes were orange and yellow, I chose the orange gnome as it is closer to red. This didn't seem to be a rule, though.I also tried going in the order of the rainbow, but this didn't work either since the colours seemed quite random. I did notice that sets of the same pairs of gnomes would come up. For example, Short orange and red gnomes crop up together as a pair often, and tall purple and brown do, too. There may be a rule here for you to explore. I tried always choosing the purple gnome when the brown and purple came together, but this didn't always give a high number either. By the end, I started to think there might not be any rules at all.  Sadly, I don't have much more by way of advice for you, other than to choose the gnome and press space to collect mushrooms quickly; otherwise, you won't collect anything. Good luck !
